scope: Read saved public problem/replay and public common rules; small Python calculation pinned CPU1; no solver, build or remote execution.

method.timeOnly: Dijkstra minimizing (move time, fuel spent) lexicographically; ignores fuel availability.
method.withoutRefill: Dijkstra over (cell, fuelSpent), bounded by actual starting fuel. Minimizes move time then fuel. Refills are not used, so a found path is a concrete feasible single-collector witness; absence is not an impossibility proof when a supplier can help.
method.movement: Public hex adjacency; departure terrain0 2steps/1fuel, terrain2 3steps/2fuel, road status0/1/2 1/2/4steps and2fuel; ponds excluded.
method.collection: After move reflection, including arrival on the final step. A starting-shop collection requires step1. Suppliers excluded. Fuel is charged on move reflection; no-refill witnesses have enough fuel throughout.
method.scopeLimitation: All other collectors can wait, so single-brand witnesses are feasible under the observed daily traffic. This does not prove that the missing brand can be added while preserving all other brands or balls, or that next-day traffic remains unchanged.
